title: Voice chat card: the Voice dialog (speed and voice) and the Language picker
gate: Gate A on 1.2.3 (decision 0010), hosted CI run 44611689138: oracle-voice-picker 109/121, -voice-picker-end 40/40, -language-picker 58/70, -language-picker-end 16/16, -hover-voice 1/1, -hover-language 1/1 (the rest is the file card, not this item); keys: the Language list as traced on 0.79.3's Speed list (traces/2026-11-09-keys.json)
evidence: 1.2.3 (decision 0010). app/src/components/overlays/VoiceDialog.tsx: the Voice row is one button reading "<voice> <speed>" ("Helix 1.0x") that opens a dialog 4 pt above it, right edges aligned: the Speed slider (0.5x to 2x, read from the thumb at 1.0x) over a grid of 28 voices, two to a row, scrolling inside 268 pt and opening with the picked voice in its middle. Pickers.tsx: Language, a list of 29. A pick changes its row (Shell holds the card's values; behaviour: scripts/lib/picker-pick.mjs). Keys (scripts/lib/overlay-keys.mjs): Language opens on its picked option, focused and highlighted; arrows move focus and data-highlighted; Escape closes without choosing and returns focus. Traced (fixtures/oracle-1.2.3/traces/2026-11-19-voice-picker.json): focus opens on the checked voice; a voice pick changes the row at once and leaves the dialog open; the slider is a range 0..15, 5 = 1.0x, 6 = 1.1x. UNTRACED, ours: Escape on the Voice dialog (as the other overlays); arrows inside the voice grid do nothing; Enter on a highlighted list row clicks it. Not built: the slider's blue focus ring (the browser's stands in) and the value's rolling digits (no Gate A case sees them). Missing: preview buttons play nothing (no voice source).
